verdict.rationale: Docs show FunctionTool/function_tool decorator turns any Python function into a typed tool with automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation, and agents are defined with instructions+tools in minimal code via the Agent/Runner primitives. Community feedback corroborates simplicity relative to alternatives like LangChain. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on code sample showing exact line count or third-party benchmark of ergonomics.
